verdict.rationale: Dots runs scheduled and recurring automations, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. Adding rules (dots-docs-20), inspecting delegated work in Activity (dots-docs-13), pausing a task (dots-docs-22), and reviewing prepared fixes (dots-docs-15) are related features but are not automation version history or rollback, so they earn no credit.
